## R environment

This document verifies that Quarto can execute R code inside the project-specific `renv` environment.

```{r}
environment <- data.frame(
  component = c("R", "knitr", "rmarkdown"),
  version = c(
    R.version.string,
    as.character(packageVersion("knitr")),
    as.character(packageVersion("rmarkdown"))
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  environment,
  caption = "Detected R environment"
)
```

## Minimal computation

```{r}
test_data <- data.frame(
  year = 2019:2025,
  value = seq(100, 700, by = 100)
)

test_data
```

## Minimal figure

```{r}
plot(
  test_data$year,
  test_data$value,
  type = "b",
  xlab = "Year",
  ylab = "Test value",
  main = "Quarto and R rendering check"
)
```
